name: svartalfar_worker
description: a Svartalfar Worker (Fall from Heaven), a dark elf: pale grey-lavender skin, long white hair tied up in a high ponytail, long pointed ears and violet eyes, a purple tunic with a pale rune on the hem over black clothes, black leather shoulder and arm guards with silver edges, a black belt with a silver buckle, black trousers and black boots with silver bands, and a long dark wooden hoe with a flat grey steel blade, gripped by the top end of its shaft in the RIGHT hand
hands: the hoe's shaft end stays in the right hand on the screen-left side; at rest the left hand on the screen-right side also holds the shaft lower down, near the blade, but during the action it lets go and is an empty fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the left hand lets go of the shaft, the hoe is lifted high beside the head with its shaft level and its steel blade out to the right
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the hoe hand behind the head and the hoe hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, its steel blade low behind the back, the left hand an empty fist tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the hoe arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the hoe is level, its steel blade pointing to the right, the left hand an empty fist
strike.4: contact: hoe arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the hoe's steel blade chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty left fist swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the hoe carries on down until its steel blade nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the white ponytail trailing back, the empty left fist trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the hoe comes back toward its resting angle with the blade low at the lower-right, the left hand reaching for the shaft

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (hoe arm thrown up and out to the left with the hoe swinging across level, the empty left fist flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the hoe held across the body, the empty left fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, hoe arm flung up and back with the hoe slanting down across the chest, the empty left fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the hoe lowering, the empty left fist hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the hoe's steel blade resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the hoe slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the white ponytail flying
death.5: hits the ground: lying on the back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, white hair on the ground; the hoe lies on the ground at the lower-right
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the white ponytail settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on the back, eyes closed, the hoe on the ground beside the body
